iterations.name: Express Swoop
iterations.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: one polished mobile adventure game app icon, a high-resolution square image. Input image is the approved SPECIAL DELIVERY icon: use it as the character, material, lighting and art-style reference. Create a closely related NEW ITERATION with a clearly different pose and composition, not a collage. Preserve Pip's round golden-yellow body, cream face/belly, enormous white eyes with dark teal pupils, three chunky crest feathers, coral-orange beak, small blush cheeks, sculptural rounded wings and tiny coral feet. Preserve the beautiful premium 3D animated-feature finish, velvety matte feathers, softly painted surfaces, bright blue/turquoise sky, warm sunlit edges and charming courier story. One bird and one cream envelope with a vivid coral-red wax seal carrying a gold star. No clothes, no hands, no extra characters. Readable at 48 pixels, a large dominant face, simple strong silhouette, eyes and beak safely inside a centered app-icon mask. Text-free, no letters or typography, no logo wordmark, no mockup, no border, no baked rounded corners. Full-bleed OPAQUE square background all the way into all four corners; do not cut out the character or make transparent areas. Iteration A — EXPRESS SWOOP. Pip is banking energetically in the opposite direction to the reference, body sweeping upward from lower right to upper left while turning his face toward the viewer. A confident excited open-beak grin and slightly lifted expressive brows; both enormous eyes completely visible. One wing extends outward in a beautiful upward arc, the other safely tucks the letter against the cream belly. Use playful foreshortening and a broad white curved flight ribbon sweeping behind the bird to convey a swift turn. Frame closer than the reference: Pip's head and chest are dominant, envelope lower center, one small soft-focus floating island and its waterfall far behind for context. A crisp royal-blue to turquoise sky gives clear separation from the gold silhouette. Keep the premium sculpted, tactile softness of the reference; lively but not aggressive. Hero character nearly fills the square with modest crop safety.

A closer, mostly frontal hero portrait of Pip hovering with a delighted warm closed-beak smile, subtly tilted head and curious raised brows, looking right at the viewer. His huge eyes are the hero. His two rounded wings gently cradle the large cream star-sealed envelope directly in front of his chest, tilted slightly for playful asymmetry, as if proudly presenting a letter that has reached its destination. Wings remain unmistakably bird wings, no fingers or hands. Crest has a slightly jaunty lean. Tighter framing with the face taking the upper two-thirds; letter occupies the lower central area without hiding his expression. A softly blurred cyan sky and two simple fluffy cloud shapes, with just a distant hint of the existing floating-island world, create a cleaner, calmer background than the reference. Rich warm golden sunlight and gentle turquoise fill, beautiful soft depth, extremely appealing sculptural shape language. Make this feel like an intimate charming character moment rather than the fast diagonal action of the original. Face and red star seal should read instantly at tiny size.
